service_name.description: Name of the service as reported to the init system (e.g., 'courier-imap').

required_start_services.description: Services that must be started before this service; typically includes 'courier-authdaemon' and standard dependencies.

short_description.description: Short one-line description of the service shown in init info.

daemon_path.description: Full path to the IMAP daemon binary.

desc.description: Human-readable description of the service, used for logging/status.
